Volume 7: The Pokémon Elite is the seventh volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the final volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Mato.

==Blurb==
On her search for famous Pokémon trainer Red, Yellow Caballero finds both human and Pokémon friends--and enemies. Now Yellow must team up with other trainers, gym leaders, and even evil Team Rocket to fight the Elite Four!

Yellow Caballero, prepare to battle the Elite Four's top trainer, Lance... It'll take everything you have and everybody you know to beat him!

==Character summary==
This is Yellow's Pokédex information and party at the end of this volume.
===Yellow's Pokédex===
Gym Badges: 0
Pokémon seen: 81
Pokémon owned: 14

==Trivia==
This was the last volume to be published of VIZ Media's original first edition of Pokémon Adventures. While publication of the second edition of Pokémon Adventures began in 2009, the first all-new volume would not be released until in August 2010, closing the longest gap between releases to occur in their publication of the series.

===Translation edits===
====VIZ Media second edition====
's color is changed from black, to a lighter color, presumably purple, to reflect Jynx's recoloring.
One line of dialogue has been changed from the original release, a scene where Lorelei asks the reason behind her 'suicidal actions' has been changed to 'irrational actions'.
